title: Leak gate honesty, contained paid sessions and safe pattern rules
goal: kbpublic.range_leaks counts a value as already public only when a file that publish's projection keeps holds it, so a value only the query-log store or a _logs.csv holds is refused by the sync leak gate; kbpublic.range_leaks reads the files of an internal root or pointer for secrets only, as tree_hits does, so a team clone's sync passes the internal-root facts the tracked-file scan passes; bench_load.paid_argv passes --tools Read,Bash and --permission-mode dontAsk beside its allow list of Read, git status and rag.py; the throwaway clone of every paid session has its .claude/settings.json permissions.allow replaced by that allow list; a paid clone's settings.json differs from the arm's own file in nothing but permissions.allow; redact.py takes --root DIR and applies that root's placeholders in its rules and in --scan; check.py's log-row scan passes the log's root to leak_hits, so a root's listed placeholder names pass in that root's log rows only while every leak shape stays the same for every root; kbpublic.file_hits takes a file's root and tree_hits, leak_verdicts and public_values read it from the nearest enclosing _root.md of the tree they scan, so a name that root lists passes in that root's files only while a different user and a GUID are still flagged there; the verdict cache of range_leaks is keyed on the placeholders of the roots it reads, so changing a root's placeholders gives a fresh verdict; test_leaks' tracked-file scan passes each file's root to file_hits; kbingest's pattern-row guard refuses a rules row whose adjacent quantifiers overlap; the shipped Lua def rule takes under 0.5 ms on a 990-letter hostile line and still names the function of function f(, function M.f( and function M:f(; PatternMapper stops reading a file after PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S seconds and notes it; session-load --intake-real's row note and the benchmarks doc state that the real row is the intake hook cut at its INTAKE_HOOK_BUDGET_S wait, not comparable with the pinned row
